title: Giant found dead at a table with oysters in a sealed tower

tellings.quote: there was a giant seated at a table and he was dead.

plain: Sometime around 1978 to 1981, at Santa Anastasia in Sardinia, a giant is said to have been found dead, seated at a table with oysters, inside a sealed tower. A guest named Tim Alberino, who also claims a 12-foot giant was captured in Afghanistan, tells Michels this as something he heard from someone else. If true, it would mean very large humans lived, or were kept, in Sardinia.
